# libmobi
Source: https://github.com/bfabiszewski/libmobi
Pinned revision: 906274205c11944b628da1c553b255acb1af7c55 (2026-10-16 checkout).
The src/ files are unmodified upstream sources, licensed LGPL-3.0-or-later.
Reader builds a separate shared library with encryption and OPF generation
disabled. Source and CMake build instructions are shipped in this repository;
the shared library can be replaced without relinking Reader.
